summary: Updated all four in-scope documentation files in personas/docs/agents/project-manifest/ to accurately reflect the post-migration state of the codebase. (1) tech-stack.md: removed persona-helpers.js row from Build Tools, removed vitest reference to the helper test suite, added @mistralys/persona-builder entry with version (^0.2.0 / installed 1.0.0) and purpose, updated CLI flags table to reflect the thin wrapper's actual interface, updated Architectural Patterns to note the template engine now lives in the library. (2) api-surface.md: replaced the two-file split table and all 14 internal helper function docs with the thin wrapper CLI interface, config file schema (suites, ledgerPlugin options), removed all buildForTarget() and persona-helpers.js references, updated all prose from 'build script' to 'library', expanded frontmatter templates to show actual interpolated fields instead of ${ccFrontmatterFields()} helper calls. (3) data-flows.md: rewrote the build pipeline section to show the top-level flow (build-personas.js → @mistralys/persona-builder CLI → plugin hooks → output files) with the detailed template engine diagram now nested as a 'library-internal' sub-section; updated the one buildForTarget() comment. (4) Created new file-tree.md: annotated directory tree for the post-migration state — includes persona-build.config.js, notes absence of scripts/lib/persona-helpers.js and scripts/tests/persona-helpers.test.js, documents all source/output directories and key relationships. Also updated README.md manifest hub to add file-tree.md to the sections table, updated constraints-build-system.md scope note, and updated constraints.md to replace two buildForTarget() references. All documents are internally consistent and cross-check against the actual post-migration codebase (thin wrapper confirmed at 31 lines, persona-build.config.js confirmed present, scripts/lib/ and scripts/tests/ confirmed empty)."
